Who Code Explorers is for

Grade 3 – 5 · Ages 8 – 10

Perfect for a student who…

  • Aged 8 to 10 years — Grade 3, 4, or 5
  • Has never written a line of code before
  • Loves games, stories, drawing, or making things
  • Curious about how apps and games are created
  • Wants to build something they can proudly show

How every session runs

  • Weekly 90-minute interactive sessions, or a weekend bootcamp format
  • Activity-first — students do before they are taught the theory
  • Team challenges and mini-hackathons
  • Show-and-tell: students present mini-projects each session
  • Fun quizzes and a leaderboard — gamified learning
  • Parents invited to the closing showcase and Demo Day

Learning journey — phase by phase

4 phases · 12 weeks · 24 sessions

Each phase builds on the one before it. Students build first and learn the theory behind what they made, finishing the level with an independent capstone project presented to parents and peers on Demo Day.

  1. 1
    💡
    Phase 1 · Weeks 1 – 3

    Think Like a Computer

    • What is coding and how computers think
    • Sequences and logical order
    • Finding patterns in everyday life
    • Debugging — the superpower of problem-solvers
  2. 2
    🎮
    Phase 2 · Weeks 4 – 7

    Your First Game in Scratch

    • Scratch environment, sprites, and stage
    • Loops, events, and motion blocks
    • Animations and sound effects
    • Build a complete catching game
  3. 3
    🎨
    Phase 3 · Weeks 8 – 10

    Stories & Creative Art

    • Interactive animated stories with characters
    • Custom backdrops and costumes
    • Branching narratives with conditionals
    • Express creativity through code
  4. 4
    🏆
    Phase 4 · Weeks 11 – 12

    My Big Project & Demo Day

    • Plan and design your own project
    • Build independently with guidance
    • Test, debug, and polish
    • Present to parents and peers on Demo Day

Projects you'll build

3 portfolio projects

Every project is planned, coded, tested and presented by the student — and goes into the portfolio they carry to the next level.

Scratch Game
🎮

Catch the Stars

A fully working catching game with score counter, increasing difficulty, and a game-over screen — built end-to-end in Scratch.

Storytelling
📖

My Animated Story

An interactive animated story with original characters, dialogue, scene transitions, and a surprise twist the student invents themselves.

Creative Coding
🎨

Code Art Gallery

A Scratch project showcasing original digital art pieces with animations — each triggered by user clicks or keyboard events.

Skills & tools

10 skills

The toolkit Code Explorers students master — age-appropriate tools, learnt activity-first through the projects above rather than from theory alone.

  • Scratch
  • Block Coding
  • Sequences
  • Loops
  • Events
  • Conditionals
  • Animations
  • Debugging
  • Computational Thinking
  • Creative Storytelling

Outcomes — by the end, students will

5 outcomes
  • Build 3+ complete Scratch projects
  • Understand sequences, loops, events, and conditionals
  • Develop a structured approach to problem-solving
  • Earn the Code Explorers Certificate
  • Graduate confident and ready for the next level
